title: ever BRIELLE|Thigh-High Slit Chiffon Sleeveless Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This one shoulder bridesmaid dress blends elegance and ease for wedding celebrations. The asymmetrical neckline frames the shoulders, while the ruched waist flatters the figure. A flowing chiffon skirt with thigh-high slit adds graceful movement, making it ideal for bridal parties and evening receptions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Side right zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
